title: Compute Grüneisen parameter from harmonic cell model
action: Implement the harmonic cell-model formulas for bead-spring chains with N=10: gamma1 = (22*(V0/V)^2 - 5) / (11*(V0/V)^2 - 5) + 1/3, gamma = (2*N+1)/(3*N) * gamma1. Compute gamma1 and gamma for volume ratio V0/V from 1.0 down to 0.95 in steps of 0.01. Save results to gamma_vs_volume.csv.
description: Theoretical Grüneisen parameter for bead-spring glass (N=10) from harmonic cell model as a function of volume ratio V0/V.
output_schema: columns: volume_ratio (float, descending from 1.0), gamma1 (float), gamma (float). At least 6 rows.
